comment: Thresholds of the lidar roof-form pilot, set before any hand check and before comparing with the generator. Distances in metres, angles in degrees, areas in m^2 (horizontal projection). The same raster and classifier (roofplanes.classify_roof) run on lidar planes and on the generator's roof triangles. minGroupN: privacy floor; a committed statistic over fewer buildings is reported as its count only.

points.note: Return numbers are 1 of 1 for every point in this EPT, so first/last-return selection is impossible; the vendor's building class (6) is used, which also leaves out overhanging vegetation (classes 3-5).
